args.summary: Built and checked the five-span (20+25+25+25+20 m) continuous spine-beam model for four precast C50 T girders per span, with the specified bearing layout and girder-only self-weight. Section integration gave A=0.802 m² and I=0.29404 m⁴ per girder; the four-girder equivalent uses A=3.208 m² and I=1.17616 m⁴, with self-weight 83.408 kN/m. The modal analysis found f1=6.0333 Hz and the JTG D60 impact factor is 0.30188. Model generation succeeded with L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passing. Reported maximum lane-load moments are +4815.25 kN·m and −3522.01 kN·m.
